invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.18.0 preserves Parts 1–19, Kenya eTIMS, international e-invoicing, readable responsive surfaces, centralized opt-in tutorials, deep permission-aware SaMi AI, and the standalone permission-aware application shell, and adds Part 20 settings hardening without inventing a schema migration: focused mobile-safe settings sections, explicit boundaries to Currency Center/Tax Engine/eTIMS, company-scoped terminology, preserved all-field saves, independent create/edit forms for payment terms and tax rates, no invalid nested forms, and overflow-safe fields, text areas and toggles. Tutorial activation remains owned only by Workspace Settings.
